title: Hermes Agent (default)
description: Hermes Agent on your project with sandbox-ai's defaults and nothing more: only its maker's model is reachable, everything else is refused or asked; its telemetry is always off.

de.title: Hermes Agent (Standard)
de.description: Hermes Agent an Ihrem Projekt mit den Voreinstellungen von sandbox-ai und nichts weiter: nur das Modell seines Herstellers ist erreichbar, alles andere wird abgelehnt oder nachgefragt; seine Telemetrie ist immer aus.

notes: The model: the Nous Portal (your login: sandbox-ai login hermes). Its hosts are open by default; nothing else of the provider's.
Nothing else is open: package registries, GitHub and every other host are refused or asked (--ask). For more: the preset coding-hermes (PyPI, npm, GitHub) or sandbox-ai net allow during the run.
Its telemetry is always off and cannot be turned on.
Hermes Agent is not live-tested yet (a start says so); its image first: sandbox-ai build hermes (a start builds it when it is missing).
